item: A source deferred for finding no pooled connection no longer counts as a wind-down reason in the pass summary
summary: Found by the Opus read of #1439. The first-checkout fix put its deferred sources in wind_reasons, so a pass summary named the most frequent reason as recycled and logged 'pass wound down (pool-timeout)' for a pass that kept taking sources, and could hide a real budget, memory or stopping wind-down that had fewer deferrals. They now go on the deferral list but not into wind_reasons: recycled and the wound-down log line come only from real wind-downs, and the summary carries pool_timeout_deferred beside deferred_next_pass. Red without: a pass whose only deferral is a first-checkout pool timeout must not report recycled.
